import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def _depot_last(z, cust_m, has_cust):
    inf = torch.full_like(z, float("inf"))
    lo = torch.where(cust_m, z, inf).min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    lo = torch.nan_to_num(lo, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    dep = torch.where(has_cust, lo - 1.0, torch.zeros_like(lo))
    return torch.cat([dep, z[:, 1:]], dim=-1)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B, N1 = m.shape
    depot = locs[:, 0, :]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    d_ci = (locs - cur.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    cust_m = m.clone()
    cust_m[:, 0] = False
    has_cust = cust_m.any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    z = -d_ci
    z = _depot_last(z, cust_m, has_cust)
    return z.masked_fill(~m, -1e9)

def heuristic(locs, demand, current_node, mask, visited, load, first_node):
    m = mask.bool()
    B, N1 = m.shape
    depot = locs[:, 0, :]
    cur = locs.gather(1, current_node.view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, 2)).squeeze(1)
    d_ci = (locs - cur.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    cust_m = m.clone()
    cust_m[:, 0] = False
    has_cust = cust_m.any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    d_0i = (locs - depot.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    d_c0 = (cur - depot).norm(dim=-1).unsqueeze(1)
    at_depot = (current_node == 0).view(B, 1)
    S = d_c0 + d_0i - d_ci
    u = cur - depot
    v = locs - depot.unsqueeze(1)
    un = u.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8)
    vn = v.norm(dim=-1).clamp_min(1e-8)
    A = (u.unsqueeze(1) * v).sum(dim=-1) / (un * vn)
    z = torch.where(at_depot, S, _mnorm(S, cust_m) + _mnorm(A, cust_m))
    z = _depot_last(z, cust_m, has_cust)
    return z.masked_fill(~m, -1e9)
